message: I remember the last time the power went out, my friend Lisa immediately started worrying about everything from the food in her fridge to how we’d survive the night! I had my trusty flashlight and a few power banks charged up, so I just smiled and reassured her. We ended up playing cards by flashlight and sharing stories, turning what could've been a stressful night into a cozy adventure. It’s funny how a little preparation can make all the difference. Do you have a friend who tends to panic in situations like that?
